title: Thousand Separator
summary: Provide an integer n and return it as a string with a dot ('.') separating every three digits starting from the right.
statement: Provide an integer n and return it as a string with a dot ('.') separating every three digits starting from the right.
constraints: Insert a dot before every group of three digits counted from the right.
hints: Scan digits from right to left.
Before every fourth processed digit, append a separator.
Reverse the accumulated characters at the end.
Counting from the right guarantees every group except the leftmost has exactly three digits.
editorial: Counting from the right guarantees every group except the leftmost has exactly three digits.
